direct_user_authorization: fix it and test it then no?
prior_exposure: One Qwen development cell; no held-out or Llama outputs
repair: Assert expected fields agree, merge dictionaries using a literal; test complete persistence and downstream analysis
reuse: Reuse saved first Qwen main capture without repeating it; preserve original failed attempt unchanged
lost_validation: Repeat the unpersisted Qwen unwrapped validation and perform the originally required wrapped repeat; both consume budget
unchanged: All stimuli, question wording, sites, models, scoring, hypotheses, annotation waiver and scientific gate thresholds
budget_policy: Before each held-out family require >=16 remaining calls; otherwise leave that whole family unrun. Fixed family order a03 then a04. If both models pass all gates, Qwen completes both held-out families and Llama a03 only: 117 total calls, 15 unused. Never select families based on held-out answers.
stop: One attempt per continuation phase, no automatic model reruns after further failures, no adaptive scientific changes
